input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, stipulated damages, penalty, kill-fee or minimum-fee-on-termination obligation payable by Clear Capital. Termination under § 6(a) (convenience, 15 days' notice with no outstanding SOW) and § 6(b) (material breach), and the duplicate wind-down provision at § 7(c) (p0044), obligate us only to pay fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the effective date of termination — that is payment for work performed, not a liquidated amount or early-termination fee. § 3 (p0013–p0015) sets time-and-materials compensation, expense reimbursement and taxes, with no late-payment penalty or interest charge; § 7 (p0035–p0037) caps each party's liability at fees paid to Contractor and excludes consequential damages, with no penalty or liquidated-damages carve-out from the cap. Accordingly the document sits at the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer) and no redline is warranted. Noted only for completeness (not deviations under this rule): Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice (p0014), which is a pricing point rather than a liquidated amount.
